content: ESA - A snaking scar on Mars Science & Exploration A snaking scar on Mars 03/07/2024 16129 views 81 likes ESA / Science & Exploration / Space Science / Mars Express A fascinating feature takes centre stage in this new image from ESA’s Mars Express : a dark, uneven scar slicing through marbled ground at the foot of a giant volcano. A broader view of Aganippe Fossa This scar, known as Aganippe Fossa, is a patchy, roughly 600-km-long feature known as a ‘ graben ’: a ditch-like groove with steep walls on either side. Aganippe Fossa cuts across the lower flank of one of Mars’s largest volcanoes, Arsia Mons.
